# Funds tracking an index: index-funds (TRACK)

The funds and ETFs of the pack that track one us-equities index, by net assets, with their cost and how closely they follow it. One row per funds tracking an index, keyed by INDEX. Read by the **funds** pack's connector `funds-store` (table `<root>/funds/index-funds/`). A **snapshot of public data**, captured 2026-10-26 from SEC Form N-PORT, Form N-CEN and risk/return summary data sets, SEC and Nasdaq Trader ticker files, GLEIF (tools/publicdata/funds.py), refreshed whole by its script (External data); 3 records. A refresh replaces the whole snapshot.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/funds/index-funds/` + `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `INDEX` |
| Date field | none in the record: a snapshot of public data, its file named by the capture date; the demo lake serves the same records on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | `INDEX`, `NAME`, `FUNDS`, `TOTAL_NET_ASSETS` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | the whole snapshot |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `INDEX` | string | required | The us-equities index code (SP500, NDX, DJIA). Source: us-equities index-membership.INDEX. | — | `"NDX"` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The index's name. Source: us-equities index-membership.NAME. | — | `"Nasdaq-100"` |
| `FUNDS` | integer | required | How many of the pack's funds track it. Source: computed. | unit: funds | `2` |
| `ETFS` | integer | required | How many of them are ETFs. Source: computed. | unit: funds | `2` |
| `TOTAL_NET_ASSETS` | number | required | Their net assets added up. Source: computed from N-PORT NET_ASSETS. | unit: USD | `587254661099.0` |
| `LARGEST` | string | required | The largest tracking fund. Source: computed. | — | `"QQQ"` |
| `ROWS` | array of objects | required | The tracking funds by net assets. Source: computed. | — | [2 objects] |
| `ROWS[].FUND` | string | required | The fund's ticker; opens FUND. Source: computed. | links to `fund` | `"QQQ"` |
| `ROWS[].NAME` | string | required | Its name. Source: N-PORT SERIES_NAME. | — | `"Invesco QQQ Trust, Series 1"` |
| `ROWS[].TYPE` | string | required | Its type. Source: N-CEN IS_ETF. | one of `ETF`, `Mutual fund`, `Mutual fund with an ETF share class`, `ETF (unit investment trust)` | `"ETF"` |
| `ROWS[].NET_ASSETS` | number | required | Its net assets. Source: N-PORT NET_ASSETS. | unit: USD | `490103179942.0` |
| `ROWS[].EXPENSE_RATIO` | number | optional (filled in 80% of `ROWS[]` entries) | Its net expense ratio. Source: risk/return summary NetExpensesOverAssets. | unit: % | `0.18` |
| `ROWS[].MEMBERS_HELD` | integer | required | Listed members it holds. Source: computed. | seen: `493`, `30`, `487`, `93`, `98`; unit: companies | `98` |
| `ROWS[].ACTIVE_SHARE` | number | required | Against the computed index weights. Source: computed. | unit: % | `11.21` |
| `ROWS[].REPORT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | Its N-PORT report date. Source: N-PORT REPORT_DATE. | — | `"2026-06-30"` |
| `ROWS[].IS_ETF` | boolean | required | True for an ETF. Source: N-CEN IS_ETF. | seen: `true`, `false` | `true` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE (the SEC data sets read), LICENCE, RETRIEVED_AT (the date the data was downloaded, YYYY-MM-DD) and NOTE. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | Where the data comes from. Source: written by tools/packgen/funds/build.py. | — | `"U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission: Form N-PORT, Form…` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The source's licence (public domain). Source: written by tools/packgen/funds/build.py. | — | `"Public domain (U.S. Government work); SEC fair access poli…` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the data sets were downloaded. Source: the download cache. | — | `"2026-10-26"` |
| `PROVENANCE.NOTE` | string | required | What the document holds and from which filings. Source: written by tools/packgen/funds/build.py. | — | `"The pack's funds whose name names this index (N-CEN says w…` |
| `_meta` | object | optional (filled in every row) | The generator's provenance stamp, one object; optional, carried through in the stored document and not read by Drishti (the contracts leave it out). A bank's extract may omit it. | — | {…} |
| `_meta.source` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source system or public source the record was built from (sec-edgar, gleif, …). | — | `"sec-nport"` |
| `_meta.dataset` | string | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The source's data set the record was read from. | — | `"funds"` |
| `_meta.retrievedAt` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The date the source data was retrieved, YYYY-MM-DD. | — | `"2026-10-26"` |
| `_meta.generation` | integer | optional (filled in every `_meta` entry) | The generator's format generation (always 1). | — | `1` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 3 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `INDEX` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `INDEX`, `NAME`, `FUNDS`, `ETFS`, `TOTAL_NET_ASSETS`, `LARGEST`, `ROWS`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `INDEX` per snapshot.
